description: This file implements a test client for the System service API of a Thunder plugin, providing a menu-driven interface to invoke various system methods via JSON-RPC, handle events, and manage security tokens.

methods.name: TimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in microseconds.

methods.name: makePretty
methods.description: Removes escape characters from a string for display.

methods.name: invokeJSONRPC
methods.description: Invokes a JSON-RPC method on the remote object with parameters and captures the result.

methods.name: showUsage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the program.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the method name string corresponding to an SME_t enum value.

methods.name: getChoice
methods.description: Displays menu options and reads user choice.

methods.name: EvaluateMethods
methods.description: Main loop to invoke selected system methods via JSON-RPC based on user input.
